items.title: Ray Vega interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 20, 2023
items.q: Betty Carter you know. She was out there taking the young bloods

ctx.x: Well you have to really love what you’re doing. You’ve got to love what you’re doing. And my wife has always been very supportive of me so like when I left private banking she was like, “Good, I’m glad you’re leaving.” Most wives would go, “You bum, what are you doing?” So she was supportive of it. Yeah. I have a supportive family. Look I have two sons that are — I have two adult sons with autism that I have to — that I am their guardian. So that keeps me on track of what I need to do to take care of business. I…

Maynard Ferguson or an Art Blakey or Horace Silver etcetera. Betty Carter you know. She was out there taking the young bloods and going okay I’m going to teach you about this. So that’s not really happening, but the nature of the business has changed so much. There is no record recording industry. Anybody and their mother can record. Anybody can put their stuff on social media and become a sensation and never have paid any dues.
Well this has been a very upbeat chat, Ray.
